user.title: Connect to Todoist
user.description: Paste your Todoist API token. In Todoist, go to Settings → Integrations → Developer and copy it.

projects.title: Choose projects
projects.description: Only the projects you tick are synced into Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Todoist
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a Todoist API token for this integration. This is needed if Todoist stopped accepting the previous token, or if you set this up before version 0.2, when it borrowed the Todoist integration's connection.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Todoist. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This Todoist account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Todoist account.

data.show_completed: Sync completed tasks from the last 7 days

data_description.admin_only: When on, other users can see the lists but can't add, complete or reopen tasks. Automations are not affected.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check Todoist for changes made elsewhere. Changes made in the card show straight away.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Adds a task with Todoist's Quick Add parser, then files it in a project and section.

text.name: Text
text.description: The task, in natural language. Dates, repeats, @labels and p1–p4 are understood.

project_id.name: Project ID
project_id.description: A project set up in this integration.

section_id.name: Section ID
section_id.description: A section in that project. Optional.

set_done.name: Complete or reopen task
set_done.description: Completes or reopens a task in a project set up in this integration.

done.name: Done
done.description: On to complete, off to reopen.
